title: T-047 Daily Report Site-Photo Document Attach + Preview Popup
description: Extended the daily-report site-photo ('รูปถ่ายหน้างาน') field to accept general documents (PDF/Office/txt/csv) alongside images, and added an attachment preview popup. Added a broad fileAccept to the site PhotoSourcePicker; module-local getFileName/getFileKind helpers infer kind from the URL extension (preserved in Firebase keys) or File.name for new blob files; grid tile renders for images and a FileText icon-card for pdf/other; new previewFile state + openAttachmentPreview router shows PDFs inline via
